voice: ElevenLabs eleven_v4, Jack - Deep Dark Horror Narrator (BVPhWQykET1TSvfGzrUr), English, one take, split into lines, inner pauses capped at 0.32 s, atempo 1.0

lines.text: They say no one who goes to Poveglia comes back.
lines.beat_before: hook: an old travel film, the boat crossing the lagoon at dusk to the island; bells; birds lift off the tower

lines.text: They say a hundred and sixty thousand plague victims were burned here. That half the soil is human ash.
lines.beat_before: RECORD card; cut to the overgrown field: the grass parts in a line, coming towards us

lines.text: They say a doctor did terrible things to the patients in the asylum.
lines.beat_before: RECORD card; cut to the hospital front: a shutter swings

lines.text: And that he climbed the bell tower, and fell.
lines.beat_before: cut to the tower from below: the bell swings by itself
RECORD card; the bells and the water build to a wall

lines.text: The record is quieter. A quarantine station for ships, from seventeen ninety-three. Later, a hospital, until nineteen sixty-eight. Then nothing.
lines.beat_before: the sound cuts dead; the film drains to today: grey, the corridor in the ruin

lines.text: Historians can't find the doctor. Or the hundred and sixty thousand.
lines.beat_before: walking the corridor towards the window at the end

lines.text: The island has been empty since nineteen sixty-eight.
lines.beat_before: at the window: the lagoon, and the boat
